text_block_list.text:
Today is the start of summer camp,
where we plan
to boost Каррен Тян's
skills.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Summer camp is held on a beach along
the coast,
and Каррен Тян is excited
about the chance to
take a lot of cute
videos.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
However, she doesn't want to film
herself training.
It appears she'd like to
curate the moments of
cuteness she
chooses shows the world.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
It sounds to me like Каррен Тян is
aiming for
perfection in both her training
and cuteness.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
